author: Molti
quote: This is what happens when you give Rockstar 10+ years, billions of dollars, and unlimited time GTA 6 still feels unfinished. Bugs everywhere, unstable performance, and somehow we're getting a game that can barely hold 30 FPS consistently. After waiting this long, I expected a polished masterpiece, not a next-gen **** Rockstar really needs to learn something from Capcom. Capcom actually understands how to make games that feel polished, fun, and responsive instead of spending over a decade making the most detailed NPCs imaginable just to have the game running at 30 FPS It's also crazy that GTA is supposed to be an open-world sandbox , yet Rockstar puts restrictions on certain NPC interactions, including LGBTQ characters. If you're going to sell the game as a massive sandbox about player freedom, maybe actually give players more freedom instead of randomly deciding which interactions are allowed.
